desc: HASC held the House side of the NDAA conference through the stripping and is the committee whose jurisdiction the Senate's independent Review Board would most directly have displaced. The pattern of what survived tracks committee interest closely: every enacted UAP provision routes its remedy to 'the appropriate congressional committees and congressional leadership' — the defence and intelligence committees — while every removed provision routed authority to an independent agency, to the Archivist acting on a board's direction, or to a court. Sec. 1687, the funding limitation that did survive, is precisely the form of leverage that keeps the armed services committees as the gatekeeper: it does not open anything to the public, it compels description to the committees.
